title: Contiguous Array
goal: Solve Contiguous Array: Find the maximum length of contiguous subarray with equal number of 0s and 1s using hash map and running count.
strategy: Find the maximum length of contiguous subarray with equal number of 0s and 1s using hash map and running count.
edgeCases: Treat zeros as minus one so equal prefix balances delimit equal-count subarrays; keep the earliest index for maximum length.
inputRules: nums must be an array of 0s and 1s, e.g. [0,1,0]
